title: '32 and want to start over': Professional's career dilemma strikes a chord. Reddit offers advice
summary: A Reddit post by a 32-year-old looking to restart their career from scratch has struck a chord online. Seeking a role that can be learned alongside a full-time job and eventually pay ₹15-20 lakh per annum, the user's honest appeal prompted a wave of practical career advice from fellow Redditors.
